Darius Acuff Jr. and Cam Boozer are making their mark! Acuff has totaled 158 points through his first six NBA games, becoming the first player since Shaquille O’Neal in 1992-93 to score 150+ points through his first six career games. Meanwhile, Boozer scored a career-high 27 points, surpassing his previous best of 25. Watch the highlights as both rookies continue their impressive starts!
